blocks.text: You can export diagnostics logs to analyze connectivity issues, troubleshoot user sessions, perform audits, or share log data outside of the Zscaler Admin Console. You can export log data as a CSV file for offline analysis or reporting.
Access to exported data is governed by your organization's RBAC policies.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Explorer > Private Access > Private Diagnostics.
From the Log Type drop-down menu, select the diagnostic log type that you want to export.
Click the date selector to select the time range for the log data.
See image.

You can export diagnostic logs for a maximum time range of 14 days. If your organization has an extended log retention policy, you cannot retrieve data beyond the 14-day limit using this functionality.
(Optional) Apply filters to narrow the log data. The widgets show the number of records that match the selected filters.
See image.
Click Export.
See image.
In the Export Data window, select the columns you want to export and click Export.
See image.

blocks.text: Review the following information about exports:

blocks.item: You can generate up to 50 exports and 50 downloads per tenant per day.
Each export is limited to 10,000 entries and a maximum file size of 200 MB. If the export reaches either limit before all matching data is included, the exported file contains a partial result.
Selecting only the necessary columns can help reduce the file size.
Exports are processed in the background, so you can continue using the Zscaler Admin Console while the export completes.
Export files remain available for download for 72 hours. After 72 hours, the export is deleted.

blocks.text: You can click Manage Exports to monitor and manage diagnostic log export requests. The Manage Exports window displays the status of export jobs and provides actions to view details, download completed exports, retry failed exports, and delete export requests.
In the Manage Exports window, you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for an export request by entering the export name.
Filter export requests by status.
View a list of export requests. For each export request, you can see:
Start Time: The date and time when the export request was initiated.
Name: The diagnostic log type associated with the export request.
Status: The current state of the export request.
Perform actions available for each export:
Click the Details icon () to view additional information about an export request.
Click the Download icon () to download a completed export.
This action is available only for export requests with the Ready to Download status.
Click the Delete icon () to delete an export request.
Click the Retry icon () to retry a failed export.
You can use the Retry option a maximum of 3 times.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.

blocks.text: The actions available for an export request depend on its current status. For example, only completed exports can be downloaded, and only failed exports can be retried.
